BEGIN;

-- Step 1: Create archive table with same structure
CREATE TABLE interactions_archive (LIKE interactions INCLUDING ALL);

-- Step 2: Copy old records for inactive fans with Basic membership into archive
INSERT INTO interactions_archive
SELECT i.*
FROM interactions i
JOIN fans f ON i.interact_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
WHERE f.status_tag = 'Inactive'
  AND m.memb_kind = 'Basic'
  AND i.time_mark < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years';

-- Step 3: Delete the copied records from the main table
DELETE FROM interactions i
USING fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
WHERE i.activity_reg = i.activity_reg
  AND i.interact_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
  AND f.status_tag = 'Inactive'
  AND m.memb_kind = 'Basic'
  AND i.time_mark < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years';

COMMIT;
